svg.text: Agentic CCR / margin copilot on a hosted ≤8B LLM - the model plans and extracts, Python computes and verifies, the output is a reviewable file
Overview | Future risk (PFE) | Crisis scenarios | Reverse stress | Copilot
Prefilter: prompt injection | PII request | execute/approve action | legal advice | out of scope
never issues margin calls or limit changes
Turns the question into a JSON plan: intent + up to 4 tool steps
Uses session memory for follow-ups ("its margin call?")
Validate tool name + args (enums) -> run tool -> 1 repair retry
Max 10 steps | duplicate-call guard | per-query token budget
Counterparty resolver (id or name) | writes session memory
10 tools: finance maths deterministic, LLM only plans/extracts (5 write files)
prices, FX, vol, correlation -> live MtM, PFE, collateral value
counterparties | trades | credit limits | CSA terms
If the draft still fails after 2 revisions,
Python renders the answer from tool
answer + Sources [S#] + "Human approval required" / breach escalation banner
outputs/traces.jsonl: plan, tools, tokens, latency, flags
OUTPUT ARTIFACTS - files written to outputs/deliverables/ (all DRAFT, pending human approval)
